contact.basis: Fixed exteriorSWreference before deck/floor/pier/section/geometry choices. Provider-relative datum not a surveyed waterline, riverbed, foundation or threshold.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Victoria Bridge Brisbane frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.4.6875m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Urban source relief may contain building/canopy artifacts and does not resolve riverbed, surveyed waterline, bridge foundations or exact approach grades. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
